**Describe the bug**

AppInformers return [read-only](https://github.com/kubernetes/code-generator/commit/87245b6442ebf48d87b67d31eb0418677836ba8a#diff-d645bf43d9617f9eb468a909d7aa9ae284f22ec45db4204ec7b33c631ce9c86chttps://github.com/kubernetes/code-generator…

f9eb468a909d7aa9ae284f22ec45db4204ec7b33c631ce9c86c) values.
Since upgrading to 2.14 we have been seeing our Argo CD Server crashing a lot more (25 times in about 2 hours). I tried deploying a patch where I made some [changes to return copies](https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/21532/files#diff-18d6bf6e8588f888e23c671094d44b6bba958c624dccb0f734f40cfe91b2f1f0). After the patch, the servers have only crashed once.

There are more areas where informers aren't returning copies but we are still getting errors. …
